node.title: E22 lower-scale filter inclusion-exclusion
node.statement: Inside any fixed residual-profile universe for a dyadic pair M_i<M_j, the condition that no smaller dyadic scale M'<M_i is admissible is exactly the finite inclusion-exclusion complement of the smaller-scale admissibility events. The identity is valid with the declared multiplicity weights as long as the intersection counts use those same weights. [DOMAIN CORRECTION, catch #46 (2026-07-10 fifth-branch replay): the minimality quantifier runs over ELIGIBLE smaller scales t < M' < M_i only — as literally worded ('every smaller dyadic scale') scale M'=1 is universally admissible, the minimal cell is empty and the IE sum is identically 0 (machine-confirmed). All verifiers and consumers use the eligible domain; petal_g3's clause (b) citation inherits this correction.]
node.attack_surface: finite set inclusion-exclusion for the complement of smaller-scale admissibility events
node.falsifier: a weighted residual universe where inclusion-exclusion fails to remove precisely the objects admissible at some smaller scale
